specs.Compatible Video Game Console Models: Microsoft Xbox One, Sony PlayStation 4, Sony PlayStation 5

features: 1TB CAPACITY: Store photos, videos, music, documents and games in one slim 2.5-inch portable drive
STORE EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE: Keep photos, videos, music, documents and games safe, organised and easy to access
PLUG & PLAY: Works with Windows, Mac and other compatible devices; no drivers or software installation needed
PORTABLE DESIGN: Slim, lightweight and easy to carry in a pocket or laptop bag for storage on the go

CONNECTION GUIDE: Works with USB 2.0 and USB 3.0 ports. If the drive is not detected or runs slowly, connect it directly to a USB 3.0 port on your laptop or PC, without a USB hub, as some laptops supply low power. With a phone via the OTG adapter, make sure the phone supports OTG
